usdRate.sourceName: BCRG, reference rates of the main currencies against the GNF, 30 October 2026 (list 0206/2026)
usdRate.note: Official BCRG reference rate; the World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF series for Guinea stops in 2020.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Institut National de la Statistique (INS), Indice national harmonisé des prix à la consommation (INHPC), September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: National consumer prices up 5.9% year on year in September 2026 (Conakry 6.3%); the 12-month average was 5.2%. Food prices rose 12.4% while health (-0.5%) and education (+0.5%) were almost flat.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCRG Monetary Policy Committee, 18 September 2026 (6.0% average inflation projected for 2026); INS INHPC (index 167.3 in September 2026, base 2019 = 100)
inflation_projection.note: The BCRG has no numerical target; it projects 6.0% average inflation for 2026, and the national index rose about 7.6% a year from 2019 to 2026, so a rounded 7% is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCRG, communiqué of the 22nd ordinary Monetary Policy Committee meeting, 18 September 2026
policy_rate.note: Policy rate (taux directeur) held at 9.5% and reserve requirement at 11.5%; it was 9.75% at end-2025.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025, table 24 (structure des taux d'intérêt, taux d'épargne)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on savings accounts 2.90% in 2025 (3.06% in 2024); bank deposit rates are free (not regulated).

fdr_3m_rate.note: The BCRG publishes only an average term-deposit rate (6.10% in 2025, Annual Report 2025), not a 3-month rate.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCRG publishes only an average term-deposit rate across maturities (6.10% in 2025, Annual Report 2025), not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025, table 24 (structure des taux d'intérêt, taux DAT)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average term-deposit (DAT) rate 6.10% in 2025 (5.69% in 2024); the average savings-account rate was 2.90%. No weighted average of all deposits is published.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No standing government savings certificate for individuals was found; the Treasury made one public bond offer (appel public à l'épargne) of GNF 1,500 billion for 5 years at 11% in 2025 (BCRG Annual Report 2025), reported under the 5-year bond.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025, table 24 and annex A8 (taux des bons du Trésor)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day Treasury bill rate 4.10% in December 2025, down from 14.35% in December 2024; 182-day 4.18%, 364-day 7.74%. Direct subscription is reserved to primary banks.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025, Treasury bond market (obligations du Trésor)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Coupon of the 5-year Treasury bond offered to the public (appel public à l'épargne, GNF 1,500 billion) in 2025; no market yield for 5-year bonds is published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Treasury bond yield for Guinea was found in BCRG publications.

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding tax on interest for individuals could not be confirmed: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Guinea page and the tax authority's General Tax Code was not read.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of Treasury bond interest for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit guarantee for commercial banks was found; the BCRG's deposit guarantee and resolution fund page covers only inclusive financial (microfinance) institutions and shows no coverage amount on the page that could be read.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found; the BCRG reports an average bank lending rate of 13.2% in Q2 2026 (MPC communiqué, 18 September 2026), not card-specific.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange found for Guinea; global equity in GNF terms; BCRG Annual Report 2025 (deposit and bill rates)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for global equities with a stable franc guinéen.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No stock exchange operates in Guinea; global equity in GNF terms; BCRG term-deposit rate 6.10% (2025)
equity_return_base.note: There is no local stock market, so equity means a global index fund in franc guinéen terms (about 7% in dollars plus about 2% a year of currency depreciation), kept within 4 points of an after-tax safe rate of about 5.5%.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No stock exchange operates in Guinea; global equity in GNF terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities repeat their strong long-run dollar record with faster franc depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCRG reference exchange rate (GNF 8,822.66 per dollar, 30 October 2026); dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a stable franc guinéen.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCRG reference exchange rate (GNF 8,822.66 per dollar, 30 October 2026); dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus about 2.5% a year franc depreciation (the franc lost 0.9% to the dollar in the year to mid-2026, more in earlier years).

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCRG reference exchange rate (GNF 8,822.66 per dollar, 30 October 2026); dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years with faster franc depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025: savings rate 2.90%, term deposits 6.10%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings accounts at about 3%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025: term deposits 6.10%; 364-day bill 7.74% (banks only)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at about 6% less a possible tax on interest, which could not be confirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025: 5-year public bond offer at 11%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: part of savings in Treasury bonds offered to the public (11% in 2025), after default and liquidity risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The BCRG (insurance supervisor) reports claims paid by life and non-life insurers in its annual report, but no life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Life insurance is sold by a few licensed insurers, but no published term life premium rates per GNF 1,000 of cover by age were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay in Guinea was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Guinea
oop_health_share.note: 54.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: INS INHPC September 2026: health prices -0.5% year on year; 7% planning inflation
goal_inflation_health.note: The health price index has been flat (-0.5% in the year to September 2026), but it tracks public prices; private and imported care cost more over time, so health goals use 1 point above the 7% planning inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INS INHPC September 2026: education prices +0.5% year on year; 7% planning inflation
goal_inflation_education.note: The education price index rose only 0.5% in the year to September 2026, but private school fees rise in steps, so education goals use 1 point above the 7% planning inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Guinea

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio. Old-age dependency ratios used: 6.20% in 2025 (World Bank), 6.4% in 2040 (populationpyramid.net/guinea/2040/) and 11.2% in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/guinea/2065/), giving 16.12, 15.63 and 8.93.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), assurance vieillesse
retirement_age_default.note: Pension age by job category under decree 2009/185 of 5 September 2009: 55 for manual and heavy work, 60 for workers, employees, supervisors and foremen, 65 for managers and engineers; at least 15 years (180 months) of contributions. 60 is used; same for men and women. The decree dates from 2009 (older than 2025).

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age under the Statut général des agents de l'État (law L/2019/027/AN of 7 June 2019) could not be read from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025: savings rate 2.90%, term deposits 6.10%
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts at about 3%.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at about 6% less a possible tax on interest; kept below the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BCRG Annual Report 2025: term deposits 6.10%; 5-year public bond offer at 11%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in Treasury bonds offered to the public.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; global equity base 9%; gold base 6.5% (our assumptions above)

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; global equity base 9%; gold base 6.5% (our assumptions above)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of term deposits, public bond offers, gold and some foreign equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; global equity base 9%; gold base 6.5% (our assumptions above)

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; the CNSS 'allocation de vieillesse' is a contributory lump sum for insured workers with under 15 years of contributions, not a social pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on a retirement or end-of-service indemnity for private employees could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), assurance vieillesse
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNSS retirement pension for salaried workers after at least 180 months of contributions (careers counted up to 30 years), from 55, 60 or 65 by job category (60 used); with fewer than 15 years a lump-sum old-age allowance is paid. The page gives no benefit formula or indexation rule, so inflationLinked is set to false and tax treatment is unknown.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take term deposits at free rates; the average across maturities was 6.10% in 2025 (BCRG).

fdr_1y.note: Banks take term deposits at free rates; the average across maturities was 6.10% in 2025 (BCRG).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No standing government savings certificate; the Treasury occasionally offers bonds to the public (appel public à l'épargne).

tbill_91d.note: Direct subscription to Treasury bills is reserved to primary banks and holders of a BCRG account.

tbond_5y.localName: Obligations du Trésor (appel public à l'épargne)
tbond_5y.localNameEn: Treasury bonds offered to the public
tbond_5y.note: A 5-year bond at 11% was offered to the public in 2025 (BCRG Annual Report 2025); such offers are occasional.

equity_fund.note: No stock exchange or locally sold diversified equity fund was found.

gold.note: Gold is mined artisanally and industrially and sold locally as bars and jewellery; no official coin or bullion scheme was found.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale de la République de Guinée (BCRG)

insuranceRegulator.name: BCRG, insurance supervision
insuranceRegulator.note: The central bank licenses and supervises insurers under the Insurance Code (Law L/2016/034).

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), assurance vieillesse

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de garantie des dépôts et de résolution des IFI (BCRG)
depositInsurance.note: Covers inclusive financial (microfinance) institutions only; no cover for commercial bank deposits was found.
